experiences.title: Senior Software Engineer
experiences.description: Design and build scheduling, contract, and media management applications for enterprise OTT and linear TV platforms serving 30+ countries, using WPF, WCF, and ASP.NET Core Web API. Own production stability across the ecosystem — monitoring task schedulers, background services, and IIS-hosted deployments, and resolving live-broadcast incidents through root-cause analysis.

projectsSection.title: Featured Projects
projectsSection.subtitle: A selection of projects spanning enterprise media/OTT platforms, cloud engineering, and applied AI.

projects.title: Content Scheduling & Media Management Platform (Synergy — MultiChoice)
projects.description: Enterprise platform managing content licensing, scheduling, and metadata for OTT and linear TV operations across multiple regions. Built .NET Core Web API services for scheduling workflows, metadata updates, and cross-system integrations, with real-time data exchange APIs to downstream OTT systems. Implemented licensing- and territory-driven scheduling logic and optimized Oracle PL/SQL packages for financial calculations, cutting critical process execution time by up to 40%.

projects.title: Advertisement Scheduling & Campaign Management System
projects.description: Core-level ad and promo scheduling system for broadcast channels, handling channel overlays, ad/campaign scheduling, and time-slot allocation. Designed integration APIs for external ad delivery and tracking systems and built database-driven workflows for schedule releases, cutting manual intervention and reducing processing time by 50%.

projects.title: Frontend Modernization POC — WPF to React
projects.description: Led a proof-of-concept migrating a legacy WPF/WCF metadata capture interface to a modern React front end on an ASP.NET Core Web API backend. Used React's component architecture and async data fetching to eliminate full-screen reloads, improving usability and cutting long-term maintenance overhead.

projects.title: Invoice Ingestion & Statistics Dashboard (Snowflake Hackathon)
projects.description: Built an invoice ingestion and analytics dashboard that automates data extraction and visualization from uploaded invoice documents using Snowflake Snowpark, Streamlit, and Azure Blob Storage.

projects.title: AI Agentic Claims Verification System (HackerRank Orchestrate Hackathon)
projects.description: Designed and built an AI agentic system to verify damage claims by cross-referencing uploaded images, a short conversational claim intake, user history, and minimum evidence requirements.
